ios.desc:
Reclaim Your Time — And Make It Count
Scroll Toll is the world’s first app that transforms excessive screen time into an opportunity for positive change. Set your own screen time limits and pledge a small donation to a charity of your choice whenever you go over. No automatic charges, ever — just real stakes that you choose to act on.

By connecting your phone use to causes you care about, Scroll Toll helps you stay mindful, live more intentionally, and do good in the process.

Why Scroll Toll?

Attach Meaning to Your Minutes: Turn each minute of screen time into a chance to support a cause — on your terms.

Voluntary Donations, Real Impact: Over your limit? We’ll track your pledge — but you choose if and when to donate.

Total Transparency: No surprise charges. You always confirm each donation before anything is processed.

Scroll With Purpose: The more mindful you are, the more good you can do. Every session is a chance to create positive impact.

Features

1. Custom Screen Time Thresholds - You decide how long is too long. Set daily limits for any group of apps. Your phone habits, your rules.

2. Charity Pledges - Choose from vetted nonprofits or add your own. Each minute past your limit adds to your pledge — but payment is always optional.

3. Pledge Tracking & Secure Payments - Easily track how much you’ve pledged. Fulfill donations anytime from the app — or not at all. There are no automatic payments.

4. Friendly Motivation - Stay encouraged with daily reminders and gentle nudges from our in-app mascot, built to keep you aware and inspired.

Who Is It For?

Whether you're a busy professional, a student trying to reduce screen time, or a parent wanting to model healthy tech habits — Scroll Toll offers a powerful, flexible way to reconnect with your time and contribute to the causes you love.

If you've tried other screen time apps and found them too easy to ignore, this one's different — because now there's more at stake, and you're in charge.

How It Works:

1. Set Your Threshold - Decide how much screen time feels healthy for you.

2. Choose a Charity - Pick a cause that matters. Link it to your profile.

3. Scroll Past Limit? We Track It - If you exceed your threshold, we tally your pledge — no charges unless you choose to fulfill it.

4. Donate If You Want - Tap “Donate My Pledge” on the home screen whenever you're ready. Or not at all. It’s always your choice.
